string.text: 快进（TAOM）
应用 TAOM 的快进速度倍率。默认与原版暂停切换键共用同一按键，这是有意为之。
超级快进（TAOM）
应用更高的 TAOM 快进倍率。默认为 E 键，该键同时也是向右旋转镜头；若不想两者同时触发，请重新绑定其中之一。
极速时间，按住 Ctrl（TAOM）
按住 Ctrl 并同时按下此键，即可获得 TAOM 的最高速度倍率。松开任一按键即恢复之前的速度。
职业能力（TAOM）
当能量条充满时，在战斗中激活你的职业技能。默认按键为 V。
统治中洲大部分地区的阵营。
{InvasionScenarioFactionId}统治着中洲的绝大部分地区。
在合理范围内，按你选择的程度随机化中洲的初始局势。
显示国界（TAOM）
在战役地图上显示或隐藏国界与国度名称。默认按键为 M。
国界地图模式（TAOM）
在各国度、自由民族对抗黑暗势力以及你的盟友与敌人之间切换国界显示。默认按键为 G。
Take the Seat (TAOM)
Lifts your view off your hero so you can fly over the field, and brings it back with a short glide. Your hero stands fast while you are up, or fights on if that setting is on. Defaults to Q.
Give the Order in Turn (TAOM)
Hold while you give an order with the order panel open, and the company carries it out after its current orders. Defaults to Left Shift.
Keep the Widths (TAOM)
Hold while you drag a line for several companies with the order panel open, and they turn as one body without stretching. Defaults to Left Alt.
Keep to this soldier or company (TAOM)

In the Seat, keeps the view on the soldier at the middle of the screen, or under the cursor while one shows, or on the company you have selected in the order panel, and orbits it. Press it again, or fly, to let go. Defaults to Insert.
Hide the interface (TAOM)
In the Seat, hides the whole interface for a clean view. Press it again to bring the interface back; it also comes back when you open the order panel. Defaults to End.
Mark, Do Not Move (TAOM)

Hold while you order a charge on an enemy company with the order panel open, and your company marks it as its target and keeps its own movement order. A mark steers archers and other ranged soldiers; soldiers fighting hand to hand choose their own foe. Defaults to Left Ctrl.
Change the Archers' Fire (TAOM)

Press with a company selected to switch its archers between firing at will, drawing their bows to hold until your word (or for 14 seconds at most), and drawing and holding until most of them are ready, when the word is given for you. Defaults to Comma.
Give the Word (TAOM)
Press with a company selected, and its archers who hold a drawn bow loose together. Defaults to M.
Take this soldier (TAOM)
In the Seat, after your hero has fallen in a battle, takes the soldier at the middle of the screen, or the nearest one of the company you keep to, who then carries your orders. Defaults to Delete.
Hold the Line (TAOM)

Press with a company selected: its shielded foot soldiers in a shield wall, circle or square stop attacking and keep their places, and strike back for a few seconds when wounded. A charge, a retreat or a second press lets them fight. Defaults to Period.
Quicken time (TAOM)

In a battle, steps mission time up one level: 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and 10. Level 10 needs the Seat up or nobody left for you to fight as. It works from the Seat or from your hero's eyes, in single player only. Defaults to Page Up.
Slow time (TAOM)
In a battle, steps mission time down one level, to a quarter of normal speed at the lowest. Defaults to Page Down.
Stay time (TAOM)
In a battle, cancels fast time and pauses the mission; press it again to go on. The Seat's view still flies while the battle is paused. Defaults to Home.
